source.label: Placed in M31 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 769,549 pc (src/objects/m31-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 776,247 pc from the Local Volume Database v1.1.1 (Pace 2025), inclination 74 deg, line of nodes 37.7 deg). The pair's own measured distance: Distance 772 +/- 44 kpc, (m-M)0 = 24.44 +/- 0.12 mag, from the pair's own radii, temperatures and brightness, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Sect. 4; it is told in the text, and the star is drawn in the galaxy

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Reeve & Howarth (2016), MNRAS 456, 1294 compute from non-LTE TLUSTY model atmospheres for the Bessell V band at 33,900 K and log g 3.57 (u1 0.092, u2 0.325): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Primary radius 13.1 +/- 0.3 solar radii, Ribas et al. radius; Gaia DR3 position; cited distance; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
